units: <cite ref="Yoma 83b">Yoma 83ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>אהדרוהו בל׳ וצעי</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, a. <cite ref="Q00961"><he>פְּלוּג</he></cite>) they surrounded him with bottles (of cordials) and dishes; (Ms. O. <he>אהד׳ צעי ולגי</he> they placed around him dishes &c.).

<cite ref="Pesachim 109a:6">Pes. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ דמקדשא</he> the Log measure of the Temple.
